recordKind: lead-credentialed-external-run (the addendum closing ppr-009.json notRun[0]'s join-plane portion)
title: The LiveKit EXTERNAL participant-join proof — the owner-delivered short-lived grant over the managed plane
environment: EXTERNAL managed LiveKit Cloud — wss://zeck-vuo9lv9v.livekit.cloud (server 1.13.7, region Japan); non-loopback, real WSS/TLS transport
doctrine: The evidence ladder's rule: record exactly what the delivered credentials permit, never more. The owner delivered the managed plane's endpoint + the API key ID + a PRE-MINTED short-lived (900s) single-purpose participant join grant — NOT the API keypair secret. The join plane is therefore credentialed and provable; the admin/server-SDK plane is not; no credential may be invented or repurposed (the grant is NOT a keypair and must never be written into the environment's secret references as one).

the owner-delivered grant was ACCEPTED end to end: authenticated, room-authorized, participant-admitted, the full signaling handshake progressed through the WebRTC offer
room materialization on the managed plane observed twice within the grant's TTL (created at 1790187441; re-joined at ~1790187471 with the room surviving between runs)
